# One More Word: "Script" {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Demystified, no code required

## A Script Is Saved, Repeatable Steps {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="script" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Saved steps, written down once,** so the job runs the **same way every time** — exact,
down to the last row.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Not a programmer thing
A "script" is just *"do these exact steps, in this order, every time."* For precise work,
the **agent writes and runs it as real code** — **you never write, or even see, code.**
You describe what you want; you get the result.
:::
